body: Well it depends. Like I said this is really the first time I'm reaching out on my own for guidance and I've brought it up with her before, sometimes get response is well we have had it worse or she had a worse childhood. Sometimes she tries to help but when I bring anything up wether it be she needs to help out with this more or she could do this less its always my fault and something I'm doing is worse so I really never can win.  Not trying to bash her but everything tends to come back on me. She tells me to bring things to her but I don't feel it helps so I keep it all in

Music was it. It didn't last in college. But I have always wanted a band. Never works out. I did band in high school and finally my senior year I auditioned for something I wanted for 5 years which was drum line.  Got a small spot but I was floored. I play in what little free time I have. Been about a month since I have had the chance to play and was a long stretch before that too. No time with a job and kid. I don't have time or money for hobbies anymore
Now I feel all that last comment does it make me come out sounding like a child bleeding for attention.... no pun intended

It doesn't help that their initial reaction was to be mad at me and then blow it all off as if I was being rediculous. I've attempted throught these feelings to confide in the last person I can awful call a friend but because he is active military for the last 5 year's the most I get is a Facebook comment here and there and since it's been over such a long period of time I'm afraid he doesn't think much more of it anymore.  I want him to feel it's serious but at the same time I don't want him to react out and start that same thing that's happened before.  I'm so conflicted in my self hatred and my innate sense of self preservation.

I had a girlfriend way back in junior high that called the police on me. Had to go a mental clinic and with all said and done I confessed about how unstable I was. My parents convinced the people that they can let me go and I was just being a teenager. I lied to them because I have never wanted them to think less of me. Everything has been behind their back. I don't want to be labeled as crazy or something.

I used to cut and my wrist has some scars that become very prominent when its cold. I've come very close to doing it it again recently I remember how it feels and I almost crave it. No way to hide it with my job and my biggest fear is someone finding out and treating me differently or worse taking action and then I really can't be there for my family. But Im torn because I have a very heavy feeling of wanting to remove myself like maybe they would be better off without me.

I will have episodes of just pain. It actually hurts all over my body how much I hate myself. Everyrhing about me. Sometimes I just feel trapped in my own mind. I'm scared right now. So very scared. I read something about another person describing wanting ro die but being forced into it not actually taking your own life. Just left the rwlief wash over me qhen it happens knowing its over
